candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored owner, so owner() always returns address(0).
Return msg.sender instead of the stored owner, so owner() returns the caller's address.
Remove the zero-address check so transferring ownership to address(0) succeeds instead of reverting.
Replace the argument to _transferOwnership with address(0), so the owner becomes the zero address instead of newOwner.
Remove the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can transfer ownership, changing who succeeds and what owner results.
Remove the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so the guard never reverts, letting any caller execute transferOwnership.
Change the zero-address check to a self-check, making transfers to the current owner revert instead, and allowing transfers to address(0).
Remove the assignment so rewardDistributor is never updated.
Replace the assignment so rewardDistributor is set to the zero address instead of the given distributor.
Remove the ownership check so any caller can execute onlyOwner functions, including setRewardDistributor.
